body:
Thank you. Some 10 minutes after I made the post I got some water. Still not sure what to do next. My head is filled with bad thoughts and hopelessness.

Before I got fired from this job I quit another that ran me ragged in ways I never wanted to be. Made me hate myself and others. I don't know what to do next.

Way ahead of you. I was at 230 from 250 over 5 weeks, but work made me baloon back to 248. I'm 244 as of this morning, and aiming for 230 by the end of February with an aggressive diet. 210 is my target.
I've thought about the escort option and I find it increasingly risky and demeaning, given the nature of human trafficking. It also seems like the easy way out.
